## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The setter should be fixed because mixed-case writes cannot be retrieved through the case-insensitive getter. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds `Cache.set`, raises the default TTL from 60 to 300 seconds, and adds round-trip and expiry tests.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Normalize keys before storing entries — Calling `set("ALPHA", 1)` makes both `get("ALPHA")` and `get("alpha")` return `None`. Your setter stores the original key, while the getter always lowercases it at `app/cache.py:17`. — Callers using uppercase or mixed-case keys cannot retrieve values they just cached.
